messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydroxyzine is thought to work by quieting activity in certain deeper regions of the brain, below the outer layer known as the cortex. It is not a cortical depressant, meaning it does not work by slowing down the outer layer of the brain the way some other sedatives do.
Hydroxyzine also blocks histamine, a chemical your body releases during an allergic reaction. This is what relieves itching.
Laboratory and clinical studies have also shown that hydroxyzine relaxes skeletal muscle, widens the airways (bronchodilation), and reduces pain. These are effects that have been observed rather than uses the medicine is approved for.
Hydroxyzine has also been shown to reduce nausea and vomiting. This is an approved use for the injection, but not for the forms taken by mouth.
Triplet: ["hydroxyzine", "has approved use for", "reducing nausea and vomiting via injection"]

The relation 'has approved use for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is officially indicated and approved for treating or managing the condition or effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
E. 'has availability': The subject drug is available under the regulatory status specified by the object entity (for example prescription only or over the counter).
F. None of the above.

Answer:
